fit_title: What the Blu EV role asks for
fit_intro: Matched line by line to the Sr. Marketing Specialist role at Orascom Investment Holding. One line is a partial match, and it says so.
fit: Marketing plans for awareness, engagement and leads
I run daily market briefs on launches, price revisions, rates and regulation, checked against sources.
Social media content pillars and calendar
I set pillars and calendars for Address Scoop and Autologist, and my tools draft each post against them.
Agency liaison and KPIs for agency output
I turn GA4 and Looker Studio data into creative briefs and optimization recommendations.
Daily news monitoring across 44 automotive sources and 62 real-estate sources, so I see conversations before they peak.
CRO, SEO, GEO and AI marketing tools
Technical SEO for three brands and AI tools I built myself for research, drafting and reporting.
A good photo and video eye
I script, present and edit my own automotive videos, and art-direct carousel photography.
why: Cars came before marketing for me. This year I started Autologist, an Arabic channel about motorsport and new cars, and it passed 50,000 TikTok views in under three months because I read every retention curve and rewrote every hook.

Blu EV sits where those two meet. Riders and fleet operators need a clear reason to switch, from up to 30% lower running costs to a swap station on their route, told in the language they actually use.
I would like to build that story, run the channels and agencies behind it, and measure what it does.
